Use a browser project with Chart.js 4 installed. Each example creates its own canvas inside a sized holder. Package imports need your project build tool and do not run in this playground.

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `aria-label` supplies a name to assistive technology. It should explain the same purpose as the visible control or graphic.
`textContent` reads or replaces plain text inside an element. It does not interpret the supplied words as HTML.
`createElement` makes a new element in memory. Append it to the document when you want it to appear.

blocks.text: The chart has an accessible name and a visible text summary of the exact values.

blocks.text: A title such as Chart is too vague. Include the meaningful comparison and units.
